upsert.title: Global Virtual Hackathon 2026
upsert.summary: Online school-student hackathon run by Canadian International School Singapore. Teams of 2-4 build a project with a supervising teacher; judging runs 26 Nov to 9 Dec. Free to enter.
upsert.deadlineLabel: Registration closes 14 Nov, 12:29 PM IST; project submission 26 Nov, 12:29 PM IST
upsert.eligibility: Students aged 14-18 enrolled in schools worldwide. Teams of 2-4, each with a supervising teacher; parent or guardian consent required. Details read from an aggregator listing, not an official site.

prize.description: US$1,000 cash for first place in each age division, plus two US$250 runner-up prizes per division.

notes: Winners announced 13 Nov. Payment subject to identity verification and tax forms.
